1: // Astro Dash – simple endless runner on <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return; // safety if not present
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
7:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600);
8: 
9:   // ------- Game state -------
10:   const ship = {
11:     x: width / 2,
12:     y: height * 0.85,
13:     radius: 12,
14:     speed: 2, // base forward speed (asteroid scroll speed)
15:     fuel: 100,
16:     shield: 0, // frames remaining
17:   };
18:   const keys = { left: false, right: false, boost: false };
19:   const asteroids = [];
20:   const orbs = [];
21:   let frame = 0;
22:   let gameOver = false;
23: 
24:   // ------- Input handling -------
25:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
26:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = true;
27:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = true;
28:     if (e.key === ' ') keys.boost = true;
29:   });
30:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
31:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
32:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
33:     if (e.key === ' ') keys.boost = false;
34:   });
35:   // mouse steering (optional)
36:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
37:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
38:     ship.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
39:   });
40: 
41:   // ------- Helpers -------
42:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
43:   const circleCollide = (a, b) => {
44:     const dx = a.x - b.x;
45:     const dy = a.y - b.y;
46:     const r = a.radius + b.radius;
47:     return dx * dx + dy * dy < r * r;
48:   };
49: 
50:   // ------- Spawn logic -------
51:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
52:     const size = rand(10, 30);
53:     asteroids.push({ x: rand(size, width - size), y: -size, radius: size, speed: ship.speed + rand(0.5, 1.5) });
54:   };
55:   const spawnOrb = () => {
56:     const rad = 8;
57:     orbs.push({ x: rand(rad, width - rad), y: -rad, radius: rad, speed: ship.speed });
58:   };
59: 
60:   // ------- Game loop -------
61:   const update = () => {
62:     if (gameOver) return;
63:     frame++;
64: 
65:     // increase difficulty over time
66:     if (frame % 80 === 0) spawnAsteroid();
67:     if (frame % 300 === 0) spawnOrb();
68: 
69:     // ship movement
70:     const moveX = (keys.left ? -1 : 0) + (keys.right ? 1 : 0);
71:     ship.x += moveX * 4;
72:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(width - ship.radius, ship.x));
73:     // boost speed consumes fuel
74:     const boostFactor = keys.boost && ship.fuel > 0 ? 2 : 1;
75:     const currentSpeed = ship.speed * boostFactor;
76:     if (keys.boost && ship.fuel > 0) ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 0.3);
77:     // fuel drain over time
78:     ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 0.02);
79:     // shield timer decay
80:     if (ship.shield > 0) ship.shield--;
81: 
82:     // move obstacles/orbs downwards
83:     const moveObjs = arr => {
84:       for (let i = arr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
85:         const o = arr[i];
86:         o.y += o.speed * boostFactor;
87:         if (o.y - o.radius > height) arr.splice(i, 1);
88:       }
89:     };
90:     moveObjs(asteroids);
91:     moveObjs(orbs);
92: 
93:     // collision detection
94:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
95:       const a = asteroids[i];
96:       if (circleCollide(ship, a)) {
97:         if (ship.shield > 0) {
98:           ship.shield = 0;
99:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
100:         } else {
101:           gameOver = true;
102:         }
103:       }
104:     }
105:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
106:       const o = orbs[i];
107:       if (circleCollide(ship, o)) {
108:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 20);
109:         ship.shield = 180; // 3 seconds shield
110:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
111:       }
112:     }
113:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
114: 
115:     draw();
116:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(update);
117:     else drawGameOver();
118:   };
119: 
120:   // ------- Rendering -------
121:   const draw = () => {
122:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
123:     // ship – triangle pointing up
124:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.shield > 0 ? 'gold' : 'white';
125:     ctx.beginPath();
126:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.radius);
127:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.radius, ship.y + ship.radius);
128:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.radius, ship.y + ship.radius);
129:     ctx.closePath();
130:     ctx.fill();
131:     // asteroids – gray circles
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
133:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
134:       ctx.beginPath();
135:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
136:       ctx.fill();
137:     });
138:     // energy orbs – cyan circles
139:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
140:     orbs.forEach(o => {
141:       ctx.beginPath();
142:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
143:       ctx.fill();
144:     });
145:     // HUD – fuel bar
146:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
147:     const barWidth = 100;
148:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, (ship.fuel / 100) * barWidth, 8);
149:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'white';
150:     ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, barWidth, 8);
151:   };
152: 
153:   const drawGameOver = () => {
154:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
155:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
156:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
157:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
158:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
159:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
160:   };
161: 
162:   // start loop
163:   update();
164: })();

(End of file - total 164 lines)
